name: XrymaCoin
notes: Xryma Plc announced public issuance for 2026-09-03 and its official announcements page remains the authoritative release channel. As of the 2026-09-05 review, the official announcements page shows the July whitepaper launch and August modification but no separate verified circulation-start announcement. Planned launch date alone is not treated as proof of live issuance; promotion requires primary evidence that XREUR was actually put into circulation.
